initial_code.python:
def cyber_ip_valid(s):
    parts = s.split('.')
    if len(parts) != 4: return False
    for p in parts:
        if not p.isdigit(): return False
        if str(int(p)) != p: return False
        if not (0 <= int(p) <= 255): return False
    return True

challenges.title: SPI Frame Payload Parser

initial_code.python:
def embed_spi_frame(frame):
    if len(frame) < 4 or frame[0] != 0xAA: return []
    length = frame[1]
    cmd = frame[2]
    payload = frame[3:-1]
    checksum = frame[-1]
    if len(payload) != length: return []
    xor_sum = cmd
    for p in payload: xor_sum ^= p
    if xor_sum != checksum: return []
    return payload

challenges.title: UART Frame Parity Evaluator
challenges.description: Verify 9-bit UART frame parity validity. Bit 0-7 are data, bit 8 is parity bit. Mode is 'even' or 'odd'. Returns true/false.

initial_code.python:
def embed_uart_parity(frame, mode):
    data = frame & 0xFF
    parity_bit = (frame >> 8) & 1
    c = bin(data).count('1')
    expected = 1 if c % 2 != 0 else 0
    if mode == 'even':
        return parity_bit == expected
    return parity_bit != expected

initial_code.python:
def robot_ik_check(l1, l2, l3, tx, ty):
    import math
    max_reach = l1 + l2 + l3
    dist = math.sqrt(tx**2 + ty**2)
    return dist <= max_reach

challenges.title: ADC to Voltage Converter
challenges.description: Convert 10-bit ADC reading to corresponding voltage.

initial_code.python:
def embedded_adc_voltage(adc_val, vref):
    return round((adc_val / 1023.0) * vref, 2)

challenges.title: NAND and NOR Logic Gate Simulator

initial_code.python:
def vlsi_gate_simulator(a, b, gate):
    return 0 if (a and b) else 1 if gate == 'NAND' else 0 if (a or b) else 1

def vlsi_ripple_adder(a, b):
    return bin(int(a, 2) + int(b, 2))[2:].zfill(5)

def vlsi_fsm_detector(stream):
    return sum(1 for i in range(len(stream)-3) if stream[i:i+4] == '1011')

challenges.title: Stress-Strain Modulus Calculator
challenges.description: Calculate Elastic Modulus E in GPa.

initial_code.python:
def mech_stress_strain(load, area, length, delta_l):
    return round((load/area) / (delta_l/length) / 1000.0, 1)
